offence_note: Conspiracy to traffic in cocaine (100 kilograms, police sting)
sentence_quote: I view an appropriate sentence as being three-and-a-half years.
note: Pre-sentence custody credit included in the 3.5 years; Bacon sentenced separately.

offence_note: Second degree murder with sexual assault and break-in; parole ineligibility appeal
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal is allowed and the sentence is varied to provide for a period of parole ineligibility of 16 years.
note: Parole ineligibility reduced from 20 to 16 years; life sentence implied by second degree murder.

sentence_quote: He received a conditional sentence of two years less a day, with house arrest for the duration, followed by three years of probation.
note: Crown appeal dismissed; conditional sentence with house arrest stands.

offence_note: Twenty counts of fraud over $5,000, about $10 million
sentence_quote: The appellant seeks leave to appeal sentences of nine years imposed on each of five counts of fraud included in an information charging him with 20 counts of fraud in excess of $5,000.
note: Concurrent sentences, 9 years on five counts and 7 on fifteen; reduction for pre-sentence custody not quantified.

offence_note: Attempted murder, break and enter with aggravated assault, dangerous driving, failing to stop, threats
sentence_quote: I therefore order that Mr. Vukaj be sentenced to a total of 15 years and six months, less time served which I calculate as two years and nine months.
note: Delayed parole at one-half of sentence for attempted murder; driving prohibition two years plus sentence; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Manslaughter by strangulation of woman in his home
sentence_quote: He pleaded guilty to the lesser and included offence of manslaughter and was sentenced to 30 months imprisonment.
note: Crown sentence appeal dismissed; credit for 14 months 10 days pre-trial custody on slightly more than two-for-one basis.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine and heroin for trafficking, dial-a-dope
sentence_quote: I sentence you to a term of imprisonment of nine months.
note: Conditional sentence refused as dial-a-dope operation.

offence_note: Identity fraud, forgery, personation, obstruction with forged letters
sentence_quote: I would refuse leave on both applications.
note: Two sentences: 3 months (equivalent to 27 months with credit) and 15 months; whether consecutive is not stated.

offence_note: Sexual interference and sexual assault of 11-year-old by kissing
sentence_quote: sentenced the appellant to imprisonment for a term of 12 months to be followed by a period of probation for 2 years.
note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed; ancillary orders unspecified; sexual assault conviction stayed under Kienapple.

offence_note: Breach of recognizance and uttering threats to cause death
sentence_quote: On January 22, 2016, he was sentenced to six months' imprisonment followed by 18 months' probation
note: Appeal allowed only to remove no-contact condition regarding his son from probation.
